title: Precision Optical Dial Micrometer Zeroing
summary: Standard procedure for cleaning anvil faces, verifying optical alignment under 50x magnification, and setting zero baseline.

claims.statement: Step 1: Wipe measuring faces with optical lint-free paper using a single continuous drag motion.

evidence_refs.cue_excerpt: Wipe measuring faces with optical lint-free paper using a single continuous drag motion.

claims.statement: Audible ratchet thimble must click exactly 3 times at uniform 0.5s cadence to apply standard 5N contact pressure. (Observable: Three distinct uniform ratchet clicks audible at 19.1s, 19.6s, 20.1s.)

evidence_refs.cue_excerpt: Three distinct uniform ratchet clicks audible at 19.1s, 19.6s, 20.1s.

claims.statement: Lock barrel screw must only be engaged after needle settles completely within +/- 0.5 division indicator.

evidence_refs.cue_excerpt: Required tools/materials: Indicator needle stabilizes at zero index line before thumb engages lock ring.

consent.notes: Engineering replay metadata only; no real-world expert approval.
